question: imperfetto forms of dire (to say/tell)
answer: dicevo, dicevi, diceva, dicevamo, dicevate, dicevano
notes:
Pronunciation: 
di → 'dee' 
ce → 'CHEH' (stressed for singular forms) 
va → 'VAH' (stressed for plural forms).

Imperfetto conjugations:
io dicevo → I was saying/used to say
tu dicevi → you were saying/used to say
lui/lei diceva → he/she was saying/used to say
noi dicevamo → we were saying/used to say
voi dicevate → you all were saying/used to say
loro dicevano → they were saying/used to say

Dicevo sempre la verità. → I always used to tell the truth.

question: Past participle of -are verbs (Example: mangiare)
notes:
Regular pattern for -are verbs:
Remove -are and add -ato

Examples:
mangiare → mangiato (to eat → eaten)

question: Past participle of -ere verbs (Example: ricevere)
notes:
Regular pattern for -ere verbs:
Remove -ere and add -uto

Examples:
ricevere → ricevuto (to receive → received)
avere → avuto (to have → had)
credere → creduto (to believe → believed)

question: Past participle of -ire verbs (Example: dormire)
notes:
Regular pattern for -ire verbs:
Remove -ire and add -ito

Examples:
dormire → dormito (to sleep → slept)
finire → finito (to finish → finished)
sentire → sentito (to hear/feel → heard/felt)
